title: Health 3
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Four predecessors own 121 words between them (a1_body 24, a1_health 25, a2_health 36, b1_self 36), which covers the whole everyday layer — pain, hurt, headache, fever, cough, flu, doctor, nurse, hospital, medicine, symptom, allergy, injury, prescription, emergency, recover, treatment, disease, ache, painful, dizzy, swollen, bruise, wound, heal, cure, recovery. Those words carry this unit's sentences rather than being re-taught. The sweep dropped sick leave and diet as already taught. What is new is the layer a patient meets but cannot say: the system and the procedure (diagnose, specialist, clinic, ward, referral, screening, surgeon, operate), what is actually given (antibiotic, painkiller, dose, side effect, vaccine, immune, therapy, physiotherapy, chronic, acute), and health as a public and mental question rather than a private complaint (mental health, wellbeing, nutrition, obesity, addiction, insomnia, blood pressure, infectious). C57 card 0 recaps Health 1 and 2. C49 all 36 across three boards of 12. Build-the-family: diagnose -> diagnosis, operate -> operation, addicted -> addiction, infection -> infectious; all four derived forms are bank items. A12 sense on surgery (operation) — in British English the other reading is the doctor's own room, which is the commoner one for a learner to meet. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Health 1 and 2 gave you the body and the everyday illness — pain, headache, fever, cough, flu, doctor, nurse, hospital, medicine, symptom, allergy, injury, prescription, emergency, treatment, recover. Those words carry the sentences in this unit. What is new is what a patient meets but usually cannot say: how the system works, what is actually given, and health as a public question rather than a private complaint.
cards.note_cz: Health 1 a 2 ti daly tělo a běžnou nemoc — pain, headache, fever, cough, flu, doctor, nurse, hospital, medicine, symptom, allergy, injury, prescription, emergency, treatment, recover. Ta slova nesou věty v této lekci. Nové je to, co pacient zažije, ale neumí říct: jak funguje systém, co se vlastně podává a zdraví jako veřejná otázka, ne jen osobní potíž.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Four pairs here — the verb or adjective, and the noun beside it.
